title: Agent spend was counted 3.4 times over; fixed

owner_note.text: Servex counted an agent's whole session cost again every time the agent woke up, so the records showed $4,783 where the real spend was $1,422. The system architect found the cause and I merged the fix; it is live since the 21:42 Servex restart. The Opus builder of the Work tab really cost $12.24, not $79.58, and the two Sonnet builders cost about $3.80 each.
